item.title: Sv summary
item.description:
koil ozhugu OG text is in thanjavur tamil university aam. Whatever krishnaswamy iyengar put was an abridged vrsn - SM

tks have uploaded all the cases where they won. I am unable to find those where we won.

any neutral person reading thru the entire set of articles in the srirangam dispute will realise that the brits were mislead.

If having vk sannidhi in tk temple was blasphemous then why is it done in kanchi alone which was declared by the courts as being vk in nature. In few of the srirangam judgements you can see that the brits compared the dispute between vks and tks to that between catholics and protestants.

item.title: Tenkalai victory
item.description:
koil olugu

Tk won Srirangam as their temple by using koil olugu which was being maintained by a tenkalai ‘accountant’. The record doesn’t mention any vdk contribution to the temple. Only a century later, when inscriptions were being read, people saw that the koil olugu is not a full record of the temple as it was claimed in 1803

Archaka suppression

The Archakas, who wear Vadakalai mark upon their foreheads, cannot even dream of introducing any Vadakalai custom into the temple. That is Ramanujarya Divyajna! They cannot prostrate before God, twice in the temple. If they dare to do so they are liable to be punished. - PB aNNangarAryaH Source: TW
